Package org.ujorm.tools.jdbc

Class AbstractSqlQuery<T extends AbstractSqlQuery<T>>

java.lang.Object
org.ujorm.tools.jdbc.AbstractSqlQuery<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
Direct Known Subclasses:
BasicSqlQuery, SqlQuery
public abstract class AbstractSqlQuery<T extends AbstractSqlQuery<T>> extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Abstract base class for SqlQuery containing internal JDBC execution logic.

    • close

      public void close()
      Closes the PreparedStatement and any active ResultSet. External JDBC resources are released, but the internal StringBuilder is intentionally preserved to avoid memory reallocation overhead when the instance is reused for subsequent SQL commands.
      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
